description: Optional, before asking a hotel's agent for a rate: prove one past trip to San Francisco (last 12 months) with its signed flight booking, hotel booking or hotel post-stay email, one email per call, to raise the user's cashback tier (1+ trips: returning, 3+ trips: frequent). Only with the user's go-ahead to send that email. The email itself is not kept.

raw_mime_b64.description: Base64 (standard or url-safe) of the original email, byte for byte (Gmail format=RAW, or Show original → Download original).

name: haggl_hotel_cashback_add_trip

code.description: Present only when the call failed: a machine-readable error code, e.g. quote_uncertain or rate_limited.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

recovery.description: When the outcome is uncertain: the tool and session_id to read before retrying.

retry_after_seconds.description: When rate limited: seconds to wait before retrying.

retryable.description: Whether the same call may be retried.

trip.description: The trip as read from the email.
